alt.en: A large orange cube stands at the center of a gray floor. On the left, an open laptop sends a dashed orange arrow to the cube; on the right, a standing teal-tinted card with a grid is joined to the cube by a dotted teal line.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一个橙色大立方体。左侧一台打开的笔记本电脑以橙色虚线箭头指向它；右侧一块带网格的青色立牌以青色点线与它相连。

caption.en: Illustration: a tool-call request (the orange cube) goes from an agent's laptop and is checked against a policy card that classifies tools, as in the design AWS describes. It does not depict a tested deployment, and it does not show that the controls work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：工具调用请求（橙色立方体）从智能体所在的笔记本电脑发出，并依照对工具分类的策略卡接受检查，对应 AWS 所描述的设计。图中并非经过测试的实际部署，也不表明这些控制如文中所述那样生效。
